fuel_kg.note: its capacity full at 0.80 kg/L (Jet A-1 / JP-8 at 15 C lies 0.775 - 0.840): one density for every tank

mass_kg.note: its listed 1,840 kg less 1,580 kg of fuel (half of the 3,160 kg Techno-Science gives two: read as full)

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.02920, its base 0.00242, its fins' friction 0.00000 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 2.3745 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.914 for its fineness 7.9 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
